top.line: How agents make fifteen minutes of an expert's review worth acting on.

in-short.line: The work to apply a review was too large; agents do it; experts comment more; book and CISO cases.

never.line: Getting value from a short piece of an expert's time never scaled because acting on it was expensive.

book.line: Reviewing the printed book with a pen, even on a plane; agents apply the notes, so I write more of them.

ciso.line: A CISO's fifteen minutes on a cybersecurity graduate's site, turned into changes with their source.

loop.line: The work, the expert's fifteen minutes, the agents' changes, the person's review; any field.

value.line: Very valuable to the person, cheap to deliver, a fair share for the platform.

limits.line: No paid review exists yet; the CISO review is an illustration; advice only.

sources.line: A conversation about a first job, the jobs that never scaled, 143 notes in a day.
